schema_description.leaf_entry: Each leaf has { en: string, zh: string, status?: enum, note?: string }

status_values.confirmed: Translation explicitly confirmed by user — do NOT change without asking
status_values.pending_review: Translation uncertain (typically MTG-specific jargon); reviewer should verify or propose alternative
status_values.do_not_translate: Protected string (API field / log keyword / internal key) — listed here for reference; the en value is kept as-is in code

schema_description.placeholders: Strings may contain {name}, {pack}, {count} etc. These MUST appear identically in both en and zh fields; otherwise the .format() call will fail at runtime.

reviewer_instructions: 1. Open this file in any editor with JSON syntax highlighting.
2. For each entry, compare 'en' (English original) with 'zh' (Chinese translation).
3. If you accept the translation, leave it unchanged.
4. If you want to change it, edit ONLY the 'zh' field. Do NOT change 'en' or the key path.
5. Pay extra attention to entries with status='pending_review' — these are MTG-specific terms the original translator was uncertain about.
6. If you change a term in section 'term' (e.g., term.sealed), please also update every occurrence of that term across the file for consistency.
8. When changing the zh value, ensure all {placeholder} tokens from 'en' still appear identically in 'zh'.
9. Once done, send the file back. We will generate the production en.json / zh_CN.json automatically.

categories.term: Canonical MTG terminology dictionary — terms referenced across the app
categories.menu: Top OS menu bar (File / Tools / Theme)
categories.topbar: Top control bar (Mini Mode, Reload, status)
categories.dashboard: Main draft dashboard (waiting / active / no-data states)
categories.column: Table column field labels (CRITICAL — see note)
categories.advisor_reason: AI advisor reasoning phrases (engine output; may be expanded)
categories._do_not_translate: Reference list of strings that must remain English (NOT entries to translate)

critical_notes.column_field_labels: The 'column.*' entries appear in code as BOTH dictionary keys AND display values via LABEL_TO_COLUMN_FIELD (constants.py:213). Translating them WILL BREAK the reverse-lookup logic. Before applying these translations, the code must first be refactored to separate the internal key from the display label. The reviewer should still verify the proposed Chinese label, but applying it requires the refactor.
critical_notes.mtga_in_game_strings: Strings like 'Detailed Logs (Plugin Support)' refer to actual menu items inside MTG Arena's client. Translating them in our UI would make instructions impossible to follow because the user must locate the literal English option in Arena. These are kept in English on purpose.

draft.note: User-confirmed. Used as substring in 'Draft Log', 'Export Draft', 'Draft Recap', etc.

removal.note: User-confirmed. Used in tag labels, advisor reasoning, and tooltips.

sealed.note: MTG limited format where players build from 6 packs. Community usually says 现开. Used in 'Sealed Studio', 'Generate Random Sealed Pool', etc.

sealed_studio.note: Derived from term.sealed. Alternatives: 现开实验室 / 现开模拟器.

wheel.note: When a card you saw earlier comes back to you. Often used as verb 'to wheel'. Used in 'Wheel Tracker', 'Wheels 80%', 'Probability of Wheeling'.

pack.note: MTG official 补充包. A pack of 14-15 cards opened during draft.

card_pool.note: Common community term. Used in pool grading, sealed pool, taken pool.

mulligan.note: MTG official 调度. Some communities say 换手.

pip.note: Refers to a single colored mana symbol like {W}. 'Double pip' = 双色费 / 双色法术力点. Used in 'COLOR REQUIREMENTS (PIPS)', 'Double Pip' reasoning.

bomb.note: An exceptionally strong card. Community standard term.

splash.note: Including off-color cards (e.g., 'splash a red removal in BW deck'). Alternative: 客串.

curve.note: Distribution of mana costs in deck. Community standard.

lane.note: An open color combination. Used in 'Open Lanes', 'Lane Pressure', 'Lane Commitment'. Alternatives: 色道 / 路线.

open_lanes.note: Derived from term.lane. Sidebar panel and overlay tab title.

archetype.note: A draft strategy template. Used in 'Archetype Gravity', 'Top Archetypes', 'Archetype Play Share'. Alternatives: 套路 (colloquial).

tier_list.note: Imported 17Lands tier list. Alternative: 强度榜.

treasure.note: MTG official 宝藏. Token that taps for mana of any color.

z_score.note: Statistical term. Often kept as 'Z-Score' in technical contexts.

vor.note: Value Over Replacement. Acronym recommended to keep; long form may be 替代价值.

pick.note: Verb/noun for the draft pick action. Used in 'Pack 1 Pick 2' → 第一包第二选.

taken_cards.note: Internal term for the cumulative pool of picked cards. Distinct from term.picked_cards.

picked_cards.note: Internal term for the ordered pick history. May be displayed less often than Taken Cards.

premier_draft.note: MTGA's main human draft event. MTGA official may say 精英限制赛 but 顶级轮抓 is more colloquial.

pick_two_draft.note: Special draft format where players pick 2 cards per pack.

detailed_logs_arena.note: This is the exact label of the checkbox INSIDE the MTG Arena game client. Translating it would prevent users from finding the option in Arena. Keep as-is.
